infamy_rebalance_y3s2.description: Y3S2 rebalanced Infamy gain (the mastery XP currency) by activity and Ship Rank. General ship combat: minimal adjustment at all ranks. Plunder: minimal (SR1-15), +15% (SR16-20), +40% (SR21-25), +65% (SR26+). Elite Warships / Sea Monsters: minimal (SR1-15), +25% (SR16-20), +45% (SR21-25), +55% (SR26+). Raw per-level Infamy requirements were also increased, but overall levelling pace is steadier early and less steep late.

nodes.description: New Y3S2 mastery mechanic. Impetus is a combat resource acquired through utilizing the season's new Seasonal Perks, and consumed to gain buffs and trigger powerful effects in other Seasonal Perks. Max 10 stacks.
nodes.name: Impetus (seasonal combat resource)

nodes.description: Generate 1 stack of Impetus (max 10) for every 8 weapon hits on enemies. Demicannons require 4 times as many hits (i.e. 32 hits per stack). Generating Impetus increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 15% for 5 seconds.
nodes.name: Relentless Force

ranks.value: +15% Weapon Damage and +15% Repair Amount for 5s on Impetus generation; 1 Impetus stack per 8 weapon hits (32 for Demicannons), max 10 stacks

nodes.stacking_note: Patch notes do not state whether the 15% Weapon Damage is additive with other weapon-damage bonuses (furniture, ship perks, mods) or multiplicative. Treat as unknown until in-game tested.

nodes.description: Generating Impetus adds a 20% chance to convert any weapon shot into a weakpoint hit for 5 seconds.
nodes.name: Weakness Finder

ranks.value: 20% chance per shot to convert to a weakpoint hit, for 5s after generating Impetus

nodes.stacking_note: Weakpoint hits in S&B deal bonus damage via the weakpoint damage multiplier; a 'conversion' is not a flat damage % — the DPS calculator must apply the target's weakpoint multiplier to converted shots, not a simple +20% damage.

nodes.description: When at 10 stacks of Impetus, fire an Auxiliary Weapon to consume 10 stacks and convert all weapon hits to weakpoint hits for 8 seconds.
nodes.name: Firepower Order

ranks.value: Consume 10 Impetus stacks via auxiliary fire: all weapon hits become weakpoint hits for 8s

nodes.description: If you enter Bracing state, an explosion triggers 3 seconds later, dealing damage equal to 1000% of your current armor value to any targets within a 250-meter radius of your ship.
nodes.name: Reactive Bulwark

ranks.value: 1000% of current armor value as damage in 250m radius, 3s after entering Brace

nodes.description: Converts 100% of the healing you generate into stored bonus damage, applied to your next attack. Maximum 100,000 stored points.
nodes.name: Deadly Medicine

ranks.value: 100% of healing stored as bonus damage (cap 100,000), added to next successful attack

nodes.description: The Seasonal Mastery Tree contains 500+ unlockable nodes (Y3S1 figure; Y3S2 'refreshed and overhauled' with 'new Seasonal Perks, Major Skills and minor adjustments in the skill tree layout'). 1 Mastery Point per Mastery Level (levels 1-80), plus Seasonal Journey rewards, for a 90-point seasonal cap. Tree scales Ship Rank from 13 up to 30 across the season. Minor nodes grant stat bonuses for build fine-tuning (weapon damage, hull, reload, etc. per community summaries); exact per-node names/values are not published in any official text source — they exist only in the in-game UI and the community planner at skullandbonestools.de.
nodes.name: Mastery Tree structure

nodes.description: Y3S2 addition: save up to 10 Mastery Skill Tree loadouts (node + perk allocations), editable directly in the Mastery Tree UI, settable per ship in the Ship Loadout menu. Does not change node values; affects which buffs are active per ship.
nodes.name: Mastery Loadouts

notes: BIGGEST GAPS: (1) The full 500+ node list with exact per-rank values is not published in any official text source — official patch notes only show a 3-perk 'Sample Perk Build'. Node-level data exists only in the in-game UI and the community planner (SnB Tools Loadout Mastery, skullandbonestools.de); their data lives in the skullandbonestools/skullandbonestools website repo, not the open snbdata package (v10.1.1 verified to contain no mastery data). Filling the full tree will require either reading values in-game, or a live-browser session on the SnB Tools mastery planner. (2) 'Sample Perk Build' wording strongly implies there are MORE than 3 seasonal perks per tier — only Relentless Force / Weakness Finder / Firepower Order are officially documented. (3) Additive vs multiplicative stacking of the % buffs (e.g. the +15% Weapon Damage from Relentless Force) is unstated by Ubisoft — DPS calculator should expose this as a toggle until tested in-game. (4) 'New Major Skills' mentioned in Y3S2 notes are not named anywhere public. CHANGES FROM Y3S1: Tier 3 Seasonal Perk requirement lowered 60->50; all seasonal perks replaced (brace/heal themed Reactive Bulwark + Deadly Medicine -> Impetus engine); tree layout refreshed; mastery loadouts added (10 slots, per-ship); Seasonal Journey now also grants Mastery Points (90-point cap). Season runs 2026-08-18 to 2026-11-17.

reset_details.description: The Seasonal Mastery Tree, node allocations, and seasonal perks reset at the start of each season. Returning players get a head start on Mastery Points based on their final mastery level of the prior season: previously Level 60 starts at Level 5, previously Level 70 starts at Level 10, previously Level 80 starts at Level 15 (accelerating toward Mastery 80). Note: a pre-launch May 2026 preview stream described the tree's stat bonuses as 'permanent'; the official Y3S2 patch notes' seasonal point reset recovery mechanic confirms the tree is in fact seasonal and resets.

unlock_mechanism.description: Earn Infamy (post-Kingpin progression currency from contracts, ship combat, plunder, elites/sea monsters) to gain Seasonal Mastery Levels (1-80). Each level grants 1 Mastery Point to spend on nodes. The new Seasonal Journey quest track grants additional Mastery Point rewards, for a total cap of 90 Mastery Points per season. Seasonal Perks unlock at Mastery Levels 10 (Tier 1), 30 (Tier 2), and 50 (Tier 3). This is NOT the Smuggler Pass — that is a separate cosmetic/gear reward track; no Smuggler Pass tier is required to progress the mastery tree.
